subject: URGENT: Contract Review Needed by EOD
body:
Hi,

I hope this email finds you well.

We have a critical contract that needs your review before end of day today. The deadline is firm as the client is waiting.

Can you please review the attached contract and provide your feedback?

Key points to check:
- Payment terms (Section 3.2)
- Delivery timeline (Section 5.1)
- Liability clauses (Section 8)

Please let me know if you have any concerns or need clarification.

Thanks for your quick turnaround on this!

Best regards,
John Smith
KnownClient Inc.
